NSTAR Electric Company files petition seeking zoning exemptions pursuant to G.L. c. 40A, §3; and approval to construct an electric transmission line pursuant to G.L. c. 164, §72 relative to the construction and operation of an expanded switching station off Brook Street in the Town of Plympton. By David S. Rosenzweig. DPU 07-9 and 07-10
